idea-plugin.name: PinGuard
idea-plugin.description:
Keeps pinned editor tabs pinned.

Pinning a tab says "I want to keep this open". The tab's own close button respects that, but Close (Cmd+W / Ctrl+F4), Close All and the rest of the tab context menu will still close a pinned tab. PinGuard takes pinned tabs out of those commands.

Prefer a safety net over a hard stop? Turn on Settings | Editor | PinGuard | Ask for confirmation instead of blocking and you will be asked before a pinned tab closes, once per close rather than once per tab.

A protected Close All still closes everything that is not pinned — keeping a pin never strands the tabs you did mean to close. Unpinned tabs are never affected, and closing a project, or the IDE is never interrupted.

Built for remote development and Code With Me: the guard ships as a frontend module so it loads in the JetBrains Client, where the editor tabs and the close commands actually live, rather than only on the backend.
